posts.title: Rise: Uplifting Deep House Anthems Vol. 2
posts.feed_hook:
Arms up. Face the sun.
The next mile is yours.

video_frames.hook:
Arms up.

posts.instagram:
Arms up. Face the sun. The next mile is yours.

On the cover of Rise, a woman's silhouette reaches both arms toward a blazing sun in an orange and violet sky. It's uplifting deep house from DJ Bombchelle, Vol. 2 of the Uplifting Deep House Anthems series.

High energy for workouts and runs, so cue it up for tonight's treadmill session or a cold-air jog.

🌅 Rise: Uplifting Deep House Anthems Vol. 2 · DJ Bombchelle

posts.title: Afro House Instrumentals for Work & Driving
posts.feed_hook:
Low sun. Open road.
Take the long way home.

video_frames.hook:
Low sun.
Open road.
Long way home.

posts.instagram:
Low sun. Open road. Take the long way home.

On the cover of Afro House Instrumentals for Work & Driving, a dark sedan rounds a coastal road at sunset, with palm trees overhead and a city skyline glowing across the water. It's an Afro House instrumental album from Resonant Theory.

A steady groove for work and the commute, so put it on for the drive home or the last stretch of the workday.
